data.description:
## Goal
As an engine maintainer I want a shared CardEventPayloads module and emitEventOrCallback helper so dealCard, placeCard, discardCard, dragDrop all follow the same event/callback pattern with consistent payload shapes.

## What to do
- Create src/core-engine/CardEventPayloads.ts with BaseCardEventPayload, CardDealtPayload, CardPlacedPayload, CardDiscardedPayload, CardFlippedPayload.
- Create src/core-engine/event-emission.ts with emitEventOrCallback<T> and EventEmissionConfig interface.
- Update dealCard, placeCard, discardCard to use emitEventOrCallback with standard payloads.
- Update dragDrop to use same pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] CardEventPayloads module exists with all 5 payload types
- [x] emitEventOrCallback helper exists with unit tests
- [x] 3+ animation helpers migrated, no behaviour change, build passes
- [x] Payload shape consistent across games (verify via grep/glob)
